TITLE: A sound that keeps rising forever?
NEXT: NEXT: You can't lift your ring finger?

EN.소리를 작게 켜 주세요: Turn the sound on, but keep it low
EN.음이 어디까지 올라가는지\n끝까지 들어 봐요:
Listen all the way through
to hear how high it goes
EN.먼저 보통 계단 소리: First, an ordinary staircase of notes
EN.올라가다 보면 끝이 있죠: Climb it, and you reach the top
EN.사실은 12계단마다\n처음 소리로 돌아와요!:
Actually, every 12 steps
it's back to the very first sound!
EN.한 옥타브씩 떨어진 소리\n여러 개를 같이 내요:
It plays several notes at once,
each an octave apart
EN.너무 높아진 소리는\n작아지며 사라지고:
The note that gets too high
fades away
EN.아래에서 새 소리가\n작게 들어와요:
while a new note sneaks in quietly
at the bottom
EN.그래서 귀는 \"올라간다\"만 느끼고\n끝은 못 알아채요:
So your ears only notice "going up"
and never catch the end
